methodology.independence: The auditor does not import the research engine or reporter. It independently reconstructs causal VWAP-Z arrays from raw Alpaca SIP pairwise intersections and implements a separate bracket/grid state machine.
methodology.grid: Every Cartesian stop/target pair was independently replayed for exact 0:188, all nine 21-session blocks, and every unique anchored/rolling contiguous train interval.
methodology.selection: Viability, Pareto skyline, eight-neighbor plateau, one-SE choice, 4/6 anchored and rolling consensus for CHANGE, dominance versus CURRENT, boundary handling, KEEP_CURRENT, and NO_TRADE were rebuilt independently.
methodology.exports: CURRENT and SELECTED pre_seen, seen, and full trades plus minute equity/drawdown were replayed from raw data; costs, split additivity, CASH flatness, and summary/cross-table metrics were checked.
methodology.provenance: All assets use 251 raw sessions, pairwise QQQ/target SIP intersections only, with unique timestamps and no resampling, fill, or interpolation. The engine hash is identical in every pre-seen freeze and source order freezes selection before seen replay.
methodology.hash_drift_policy: A differing independent decimal CSV SHA is a warning only after a disposable production-kernel replay exactly reproduces the frozen SHA, every independent fold choice/reason matches, maximum cell delta is at most 5e-11, and no cell exceeds audit tolerance 7e-7. The production kernel was used only for this hash reproducibility diagnosis, never for independent metric or selection verification.

conclusion: All nine frozen selections, no-trade decisions, split exports, and cross-asset artifacts pass the independent audit. Hash-only differences are quantified sub-5e-11 serialization drift and do not change any metric gate, fold choice, or verdict.
